text: I personnaly dont like it. It feel more like a personnal development app than adhd related. Even if 1 or 2 thing may work in specific situation its general advise not adhd. I won't say it s insulting bc seems to come from a goid place but not for the right public. it s just really not for struggling adhders in my opinion.
author: Kit Mayers
developer_reply: Hi, we appreciate your compliments on the app's design. We provide psychoeducational tips for ADHDers but encourage consulting a psychologist for personalized advice. Univi aims to offer support but is not a substitute for medical help. If you could consider changing your rating, it would greatly help us grow. M, Univi's founder & your ADHD friend.

text: I found this app quite insulting to ADHDers. It advises you, if a task takes less than 2 minutes, don't procrastinate just do it. As if it were that simple, it seems they haven't understood that we have no notion of time in general, which also means estimating time of a task is rarely accurate with the time it really take. This app feels like a neuro typical person advice. 👎
author: Linzi Laszlo-Carr
developer_reply: Hi Linzi, We offer various tools as ADHD experiences differ. While the 2-minute rule may not suit you, our planner and meditations might. We're open to your suggestions - martyna@univi.app. If you consider changing your rating, I would appreciate it. I'm doing this app from the bottom of my heart and from my experience. Much love <3
